summary.one_liner: This guides index outlines topics for reaching and succeeding in Staff-plus engineering roles, from what Staff engineers do to switching companies and interviewing.
keywords: where staff engineers fit in the org
takeaways: Staff-plus roles are a senior individual contributor track, separate from management.
The guide covers what Staff engineers actually do and how to operate at that level.
Topics include getting the Staff title at your current company or by switching companies.
It also covers staying aligned with authority, getting in the room, and interviewing for Staff-plus roles.
The page is an index; many linked sections are listed but their content is not in the page text.
